candidate_selection: Validate every candidate passing both original windows and both original base/stress scenarios; do not select candidates or change rules after sensitivity results.

rolling_windows.endpoints: Every completed NYSE month end supported by a common continuously managed account.
rolling_windows.accounting: Slices of continuous net return paths; not newly fitted rules or separately reinitialized accounts.
rolling_windows.purpose: Report sensitivity to historical endpoints, not a replacement for the preregistered primary windows.

metric_audit: Independently derive returns from bt equity, use ffn for calendar CAGR and maximum drawdown, and independently calculate excess-return Sharpe using the same lagged IRX series.
scope: These are diagnostics of unchanged rules and execution assumptions, not additional candidate hypotheses or parameter optimization.
